question: Should `appendFile?` become the permanent public `SandboxFsBridge` capability used to expose `append: true` on the built-in write tool?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but accepting a new model-facing tool parameter and public Plugin SDK bridge method determines a lasting compatibility contract that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the optional capability
options.body: Accept `appendFile?` as the canonical bridge seam, preserve capability-gated schemas, and merge after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Retain the native core behavior but revise the design so external Plugin SDK bridges do not receive a new public method yet.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the linked data-loss issue open and close or pause this PR until maintainers choose a different append ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional capability
recommendation.body: Accept `appendFile?` as the canonical bridge seam, preserve capability-gated schemas, and merge after exact-head checks complete.
